# Rudolph Valentino Mills III

> Founder of Push to Build, purpose-first consulting on biblical principles. Keynote speaker based in Rochester, New York, who helps people turn pain into purpose through the H.U.R.T. Framework (Hurt Happens, Understand the Process, Reframe the Pain, Trust the Purpose).

## Signature talk
"Your Pain Is Not Your Problem: It's Proof of Your Purpose"

## Topics
Purpose; healing and resilience; fatherhood and family; leadership; faith-based motivation; reentry and second chances.

## Formats and fees
- Local nonprofit keynote: from $1,500
- Corporate keynote: from $2,500
- Workshop: $2,500 to $3,500
- Half-day training: $3,500 to $5,000
- Full-day training: $5,000 to $7,500
- Virtual keynote: $750 to $1,000
- Coaching
A 50% deposit holds a date. Local travel included in the Rochester area; available to travel.

## Roles
Fatherhood Program Manager, Healthy Baby Network (Rochester, NY); founder and leader, Worship Experience Ministries; CEO, WE C.A.R.E. Family Initiative.

## Books
The Preacher's Corner, Volume One (author); Same Destination, Different Journey (co-author); From Motivation to Legacy: M.A.D.E MAN and MADE D.A.D (author).
